# Simulate simple synchronous diagonal attraction to grid center.
def sim(objs,H,W,n=100):
    # objs list r,c,h,w
    objs=[list(x) for x in objs]
    for t in range(n):
        desires=[]
        for r,c,h,w in objs:
            cr=r+(h-1)/2; cc=c+(w-1)/2
            dr=(cr<(H-1)/2)-(cr>(H-1)/2)
            dc=(cc<(W-1)/2)-(cc>(W-1)/2)
            desires.append((r+dr,c+dc))
        def overlap(a,b):
            r,c,h,w=a; R,C,Hh,Ww=b
            return r<R+Hh and R<r+h and c<C+Ww and C<c+w
        moved=False
        # synchronous accept if no collision with any desired or stationary object
        for i,(r,c,h,w) in enumerate(objs):
            nr,nc=desires[i]
            if (nr,nc)==(r,c): continue
            cand=(nr,nc,h,w)
            collision=False
            for j,(R,C,hh,ww) in enumerate(objs):
                if i==j:continue
                other=(*desires[j],hh,ww)
                if overlap(cand,other): collision=True
            if not collision:
                objs[i][0:2]=[nr,nc];moved=True
        if not moved:break
    return objs
